title.zh: Copilot、Work IQ 与 Agent 365 无断崖统一智能体控制背板（LIVE47）
title.en: Unified Backplane Across Copilot, Work IQ, and Agent 365 (LIVE47)

label.zh: 1. 主动式协同与多元智能体入口层（Proactive Work Surfaces & Heterogeneous Fleet）
label.en: 1. Proactive Work Surfaces & Heterogeneous Agent Fleet

label.zh: 2. 无断崖共享背板层（Work IQ 图谱 · 共享插件注册表 · Entra 智能体身份）
label.en: 2. Seamless Shared Backplane (Work IQ · Unified Plugin Registry · Entra Identity)

label.zh: 3. Agent 365 全域治理与可观测底座（“智能体时代的 Intune” · 跨云开箱即连）
label.en: 3. Agent 365 Estate Control Plane ("Intune for Agents" · Cross-Cloud Governance)

detail.zh: 免提示词推送晨间五件要事简报、人机共创项目空间与全天候巡航（如 Apollo）
detail.en: Zero-prompt top-5 weekly briefs, shared project workspaces, and perpetual Autopilot

label.zh: Copilot Studio · Foundry · GitHub 智能体

detail.zh: 跨低代码流程重构、专业模型编排与研发协同工具构建的第一方智能体矩阵
detail.en: First-party agents built across low-code studios, pro-code Foundry, and GitHub

label.zh: 多云异构智能体（Anthropic / AWS / GCP）

detail.zh: 拥抱企业真实异构生态，非微软运行时智能体同享统一日志注入与花费核算
detail.en: Supports real-world multi-vendor fleets with native telemetry and spend ingestion

label.zh: Work IQ 工作与人脉语义图谱
label.en: Work IQ Semantic Work & People Graph

detail.zh: 理解协作关系、紧急汇报链与在途项目上下文，驱动主动式任务推荐与发起
detail.en: Understands org urgency, collaborators, and active projects for proactive actions

label.zh: 统一插件与技能注册表（Plugin Registry）

detail.zh: 一处注册即可跨 GitHub Copilot、Copilot 与 Autopilot 一致发现并受控加载
detail.en: Single catalog to discover and govern skills across GitHub Copilot, Copilot, and Autopilot

label.zh: Microsoft Entra 智能体身份与零信任隔离
label.en: Entra Agent IDs & Zero Trust Isolation

detail.zh: 复用已正式商用的 Entra Agent ID / User ID、网络与密钥隔离及 Windows MXC 容器
detail.en: Extends GA Entra Agent IDs, ACLs, network/secret isolation, and MXC for Windows

label.zh: Agent 365 商业分析与花费封顶看板

detail.zh: 充当跨生态 AI 支出的 ERP/BI 仪表盘，同步设定预算上限、预测并核算产出价值
detail.en: Acts as the ERP/BI dashboard for Microsoft and non-Microsoft AI spend vs. value

detail.zh: 追踪连接目标、工具来源、决策轨迹与报错，双向打通企业既有数据湖与 SIEM
detail.en: Captures tool calls, plugin provenance, and decision chains; exports to lake & SIEM

label.zh: 全域智能体资产盘点与统一管理控制

detail.zh: 如同 Intune 统管 iOS/Android/PC/Mac，一套管理台纳管任意平台的智能体生命周期
detail.en: Just as Intune manages iOS, Android, PC, and Mac, Agent 365 governs every runtime
